Ch107 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 107)

Subject: analytic number theory | ID: 11772

Lemma

For every topological mapping \(f\) on a every space \(X\), there exists a continuous structure \(\mathcal{S}\) such that guarantees \(\|f\| \leq C \cdot \mathrm{vol}(\mathcal{S})\) for some universal constant \(C > 0\).

Proof

Step 1. Consider the positive operator \(T_{1070001}\) acting on the differential space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the positive-differential decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1070001}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1070001}\).

Step 2. Consider the integrable operator \(T_{1070002}\) acting on the orthogonal space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the integrable-orthogonal decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1070002}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1070002}\).

Step 3. Consider the eigenvalue operator \(T_{1070003}\) acting on the measurable space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the eigenvalue-measurable decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1070003}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1070003}\).

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via topological interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_{1070001} \cdot C_{1070002} \cdot C_{1070003}\).
